title: DevMegle
oneLiner: A developer networking site built end to end in 24 hours.
shortSummary: A hackathon build: a site pairing developers for short technical conversations, designed and shipped inside a 24-hour window.
responsibilities: Scoped what could realistically ship in 24 hours and cut the rest.
Built the site front to back within the window.
constraints: A hard 24-hour deadline, which set the scope more than anything else did.
outcomes: Completed and demonstrated within the hackathon window.
